notes.title: Exiled is a new compact puzzle thriller from the director of My Friendly Neighborhood
notes.notes:
Up for being puzzled and thrilled at the same time in a compact setting? John Szymanski, director of My Friendly Neighborhood, has released a standalone version of Exiled.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/01/exiled-is-a-new-compact-puzzle-thriller-from-the-director-of-my-friendly-neighborhood
